title: Blocked Sources
description: Per-IP traffic rejected by Cloudflare (proxied path) and Cilium (direct path). Client IPs are parsed from logs at query time, never metric labels.

panels.title: Cloudflare blocked requests
panels.description: Sum of blocked requests reported by Cloudflare Security Events in the selected range.

panels.title: Cloudflare collector age
panels.description: Time since the last successful Security Events collection. Requires Zone Analytics: Read on the API token.

panels.title: Cloudflare collector errors
panels.description: Failed Security Events collections in the range, by reason.

panels.title: Cilium Gateway dropped flows
panels.description: Non-reply DROPPED flows involving reserved:ingress (identity 8), with POLICY_DENIED or no recorded reason. Reasonless flows are not proof of an AbuseIPDB or L7-policy block. These are flow events, not unique HTTP requests.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="hubble-flows"} | json | __error__="" | flow_verdict="DROPPED" | flow_is_reply!="true" | (flow_source_identity="8" or flow_destination_identity="8") | (flow_drop_reason_desc="POLICY_DENIED" or flow_drop_reason_desc="") [$__range]))

panels.title: Cloudflare blocks over time
panels.description: Blocked requests per minute, split by Cloudflare rule source. firewallCustom includes custom rules generally; inspect rule_id to identify the managed AbuseIPDB rule.

panels.title: Cilium Gateway dropped flows over time
panels.description: Non-reply dropped flows per minute involving reserved:ingress (identity 8). POLICY_DENIED confirms policy enforcement, but not which policy; reasonless drops remain unattributed. Source or destination may be the ingress identity because Envoy emits both ingress and egress events.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="hubble-flows"} | json | __error__="" | flow_verdict="DROPPED" | flow_is_reply!="true" | (flow_source_identity="8" or flow_destination_identity="8") | flow_drop_reason_desc="POLICY_DENIED" [1m]))

sum(count_over_time({job="hubble-flows"} | json | __error__="" | flow_verdict="DROPPED" | flow_is_reply!="true" | (flow_source_identity="8" or flow_destination_identity="8") | flow_drop_reason_desc="" [1m]))

panels.title: Top blocked client IPs (Cloudflare)
panels.description: Client IPs blocked at the Cloudflare edge, parsed from the Security Events log body. Shows at most the top 20 entries; ties can hide the remaining values.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (client_ip) (sum_over_time({job="cloudflare-firewall"} | json | unwrap count | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Top dropped source IPs (Cilium Gateway)
panels.description: Source IPs from the same Gateway drop filter as the overview. For proxied traffic this can be a Cloudflare edge address; reasonless drops are not attributed to a particular policy. Shows at most the top 20 entries; ties can hide the remaining values.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (flow_IP_source) (count_over_time({job="hubble-flows"} | json | __error__="" | flow_verdict="DROPPED" | flow_is_reply!="true" | (flow_source_identity="8" or flow_destination_identity="8") | (flow_drop_reason_desc="POLICY_DENIED" or flow_drop_reason_desc="") | flow_IP_source!="" | flow_IP_source!="::" | flow_IP_source!~"fe80:.*" [$__range])))

panels.title: Top blocked countries (Cloudflare)

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (country) (sum_over_time({job="cloudflare-firewall"} | json | unwrap count | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.description: Shows at most the top 20 entries; ties can hide the remaining values.

panels.title: Sampled paths in blocked groups (Cloudflare)
panels.description: Each client/rule/host/minute group retains its first path and attributes the group's count to that sample. This is not an exact per-path request ranking. Shows at most the top 20 sampled values.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (path) (sum_over_time({job="cloudflare-firewall"} | json | path=~".+" | unwrap count | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Top dropped TCP ports (Cilium Gateway)

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (flow_l4_TCP_destination_port) (count_over_time({job="hubble-flows"} | json | __error__="" | flow_verdict="DROPPED" | flow_is_reply!="true" | (flow_source_identity="8" or flow_destination_identity="8") | (flow_drop_reason_desc="POLICY_DENIED" or flow_drop_reason_desc="") | flow_l4_TCP_destination_port=~".+" [$__range])))

panels.description: Shows at most the top 20 entries; ties can hide the remaining values.

panels.title: Sampled user agents in blocked groups (Cloudflare)
panels.description: Each client/rule/host/minute group retains its first user agent and attributes the group's count to that sample. This is not an exact per-user-agent request ranking. Shows at most the top 20 sampled values.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (user_agent) (sum_over_time({job="cloudflare-firewall"} | json | user_agent=~".+" | unwrap count | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Recent Cloudflare blocks (latest 100)
panels.description: Raw aggregated Security Events (per client IP, rule source, minute). Displays at most the latest 100 records; the stat and time-series panels above count all matching events.

targets.expr: {job="cloudflare-firewall"} | json | line_format `{{.action}} {{.source}} ip={{.client_ip}} host={{.host}} path={{.path}} ua={{.user_agent}} hits={{.count}}`

panels.title: Recent Cilium Gateway drops (latest 100)
panels.description: Non-reply dropped flows involving reserved:ingress, with POLICY_DENIED or no recorded reason. Uses the same filter as the overview. Displays at most the latest 100 records; the stat and time-series panels above count all matching events.

targets.expr: {job="hubble-flows"} | json | __error__="" | flow_verdict="DROPPED" | flow_is_reply!="true" | (flow_source_identity="8" or flow_destination_identity="8") | (flow_drop_reason_desc="POLICY_DENIED" or flow_drop_reason_desc="") | line_format `{{.flow_verdict}} {{.flow_drop_reason_desc}} src={{.flow_IP_source}} dst={{.flow_IP_destination}} port={{.flow_l4_TCP_destination_port}} dir={{.flow_traffic_direction}}`

options.content:
**Cloudflare (proxied path, real client IPs)** — collected by `abuseipdb-sync` from Security Events into Loki (`job="cloudflare-firewall"`). Needs `Zone Analytics: Read`; free-plan API retention is 24h. Paths and user agents are first-event samples per client/rule/host/minute group, not exact rankings. `firewallCustom` is a rule source, not a unique AbuseIPDB rule identifier.

**Cilium Gateway** — shows non-reply `DROPPED` flows with source or destination identity **8** (`reserved:ingress`) and either `POLICY_DENIED` or no recorded reason. The export omits L7/policy details: reasonless drops cannot be attributed to AbuseIPDB or default-deny from these records alone. Counts are flow events, not unique requests. For proxied traffic Cilium can see Cloudflare edge addresses; use the edge panels for real client IPs.

**Display limits** — ranking tables show at most the top 20 entries and sample panels at most the latest 100 records; aggregate stat and time-series panels count every matching event in the selected range.
